resize_pos_embed: resize position embedding weights from source shape to destination shape using bicubic interpolation
resize_relative_position_bias_table: resize relative position bias table for pretrained model using cubic interpolation and geometric progression
build_PatchEmbed: build a PatchEmbed module to convert input images into patch embeddings using a convolutional projection layer
build_HybridEmbed: build a HybridEmbed module to extract feature maps from a CNN backbone and project to embedding dimensions
build_PatchMerging: build a PatchMerging module to merge patch feature maps using nn.Unfold for Swin Transformer hierarchical downsampling
